verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a feature for sharing availability or inserting bookable meeting times into an email. The only related evidence is that the AI assistant can "check your calendar" and write drafts, and that it can connect to Calendar. Those are adjacent capabilities, not a documented availability-sharing or booking-link feature, so they earn no credit. Calendar integration is a fair axis for an email client, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
